findings.title: [P1] Preserve validation of previously retained runtime policies
findings.body: Making `payloadStructure` unconditionally required rejects every previously valid retained policy that contains only `operatorMessagingPayload.targetPayloadProfiles`. Recovery passes retained policies through `captureCoreRuntimePolicy()` in `inspectRuntimeConfiguration()`, so runs captured before this change now fail with `CORE_RUNTIME_POLICY_INVALID` before adapters can activate. The policy version remains unchanged, and accepting both document versions does not address this new required field. Add version-aware compatibility handling that preserves the original structural limits for retained policies while requiring explicit selection for new policies.

overall_explanation: The configuration externalization introduces a retained-policy compatibility regression that prevents recovery of previously captured runs. Review used the supplied source datasets; shell inspection was unavailable, and no tests or native execution were performed.
